name: call4me not calling yet (synthetic)
description: Synthetic 422 from POST /api/calls when a category's required details are missing, shaped after the real refusal body ({error}). Nothing is dialed.

body.error:
Not calling yet: a restaurant reservation call needs more information from the user. Ask them (in one message), then call call4me_place_call again with the answers in "details":
- party_size: How many people?
